name: cells
title: Cells
description: A grid of cells, each with a small square. Near the pointer the squares swell to fill their cells in a soft dome, trailing it; they shrink back when it leaves.
docs: One self-contained file, react only: no Tailwind, no other dependency. Mount <Cells /> inside an element with position: relative and a size; it covers that element and is decoration only: give it no link or click handler. Suggested commit: feat: add Cells hover texture (textures.dev/s/cells)
